release_notes: Added application-wide structured logging for startup, shutdown, settings, profiles, practice sessions, serial connections, windows, statistics, debugging tools and update checks.
Improved diagnostics for practice lifecycle events, including round start, round finish, saving, deferred updates and skill rating snapshots.
Added safer logging helpers that avoid storing raw Morse telemetry, full target text or full entered text in normal application logs.
Improved logging around profile management, database maintenance, settings persistence and application restart/shutdown cleanup.
Added additional logging and sanitization tests for application logging and sensitive context masking.
Improved network-related tests for public room handling and client-side manager behaviour.
Fixed practice countdown and round-start logging issues.
General bug fixes and stability improvements.
Improved overall application behaviour and user experience.
